8.3.5 CanXL_GetCurrentTimeTuple
[CP_SWS_CanXL_90000] Definition of API function CanXL_GetCurrentTimeTu-
ple
Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
CanXL_GetCurrentTimeTuple (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType CanXL_GetCurrentTimeTuple (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
uint8 ClkUnitIdx,
TimeTupleType currentTimeTuplePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x22
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
CtrlIdx
Index of the addressed controller
Parameters (in)
ClkUnitIdx
Index of the addressed clock unit to provide the time tuple
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
currentTimeTuplePtr
Current time provided as time tuple
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Current time successfully provided
E_NOT_OK:Current time not available
Description
Reads the time tuple of the current time of the timestamp clock and the current time of the PHC
in an atomic operation. If no PHC is supported, the PHC value will be a copy of the timestamp
clock value.
